sample_knowledge.content: The Transformer architecture was introduced in the paper 'Attention Is All You Need' by Vaswani et al. in 2017. It relies entirely on an attention mechanism, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.
BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) is a pre-trained transformer model developed by Google. It uses bidirectional training of Transformer and was released in 2018.
GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) is a series of language models by OpenAI. GPT-4 (2023) is a multimodal model capable of processing images and text. The architecture is decoder-only.

Flash Attention (Dao et al., 2022) is an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that uses tiling to reduce memory reads/writes. It achieves 2-4x speedup and 5-20x memory reduction over standard attention.
